title: [review] provisioning.py:485: Existing session overwritten w
description: create_node_session() has the same issue as create_br_session() - overwrites existing sessions without secure cleanup.
close_reason: Fixed: create_node_session() now checks for existing session and calls _remove_session(existing, wipe=True) before creating a new session, ensuring cryptographic material from the old session is securely cleared before overwrite.
